ValidationRule.description: A cloned project must start clean: not approved, no spend, Draft, 0% complete and no stale kickoff or epoch.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISNEW(), ISCLONE(), OR( Is_Approved__c, NULLVALUE(Spent__c, 0) > 0, NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Draft')), NULLVALUE(Completion_Pct__c, 0) > 0, AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Kickoff_At__c)), Kickoff_At__c < NOW()), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Epoch_Seconds__c)), Epoch_Seconds__c < UNIXTIMESTAMP(NOW())) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Cloned projects must be reset (Draft, unapproved, no spend, no stale dates).
